What happens when you call

  1. Choose pressure washing. The number also handles roofing and air conditioning, so the assistant asks which you need.
  2. Describe the job. What needs cleaning, roughly how big, and where.
  3. Get put through. An independent local pressure washing company picks up, already knowing the basics. If it is out on a job, it calls you back.

Houston Power Washing Pro is a free phone line, not a pressure washing company. It connects you with an independent local pressure washing company, which inspects, quotes, does the work and is paid by you directly. Houston Power Washing Pro never charges callers. It may be paid a referral fee by the companies it connects callers with.

Send a Cleaning Request

A local company will call you back. If you would rather talk now, call (832) 662-4107.

Your details go only to the company that will call you back. They are not sold. By sending, you agree to the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Tips for a useful request

  • List every surface you want done: the company can plan one visit instead of two.
  • Give a rough size, like "two-car driveway" or "two-story house."
  • Mention any deadline, such as an HOA letter date or a closing.
  • Note anything delicate: fresh paint, new landscaping, a koi pond, an outdoor kitchen.

Common questions

When will someone call me back after I send the form?

Your request goes to the local company handling it, and that company calls you back. Houston Power Washing Pro does not set or promise a call-back time. If it is urgent, calling (832) 662-4107 is faster.

Is there an email address or office I can visit?

No. Houston Power Washing Pro is a phone line and website without a public office or email. Call the number or use the form.

Can I send photos?

The form does not take photos, but the company that calls you back may ask you to text some. Photos of the problem areas help it understand the job.

Does sending a request commit me to anything?

No. A request only asks a local company to contact you. You decide whether to accept its price.
